svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Order approval flowchart
svg.desc: Order approval flowchart. 13 components. Connections: Order received to Enter order details; Enter order details to Run credit check; Run credit check to Credit OK?; Credit OK? to Over the limit? (yes); Credit OK? to Ask for prepayment (no); Over the limit? to Manager signs off (yes); Over the limit? to Reserve stock (no); Manager signs off to Reserve stock; Ask for prepayment to Wait for payment; Wait for payment to Paid in time?; Paid in time? to Reserve stock (yes); Paid in time? to Order rejected (no); Reserve stock to Print invoice; Print invoice to Order approved.

text.tspan: An order that fails the credit check must be paid up front; one over the credit limit needs a manager's sign-off
